knott_historian.text: Knott Mill. Even the railway station nearby borrowed the name.
Castlefield was where the Romans built a fort called Mamucium around AD 79.
Manchester's very name comes from it. The city is an old Roman outpost with a good rain gauge.

manchester_quizmaster.text: Evening all, welcome to the taproom quiz at Knott Mill. Yes, it's a mill. Yes, there's a bar now. Don't ask, it's Manchester.
Five questions. Phones away. If I catch anyone googling, I'm sending you out into the rain, which is easy, because it's always raining.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: No worries. Mind how you go, it's slippy out.
